trs.20: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.<sup foot_note=196947>1</sup>
trs.85: Ta Sin Mim
trs.22: Ta. Sin. Mim.
trs.203: Tâ-Sîn-Mîm.

trs.20: These are the verses of the clear Book.
trs.85: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
trs.22: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
trs.203: These are the Verses of the manifest Book [(this Qur’ân), which was promised by Allâh in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear].

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
trs.85: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
trs.22: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
trs.203: It may be that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) i.e. in your Message of Islâmic Monotheism].<sup foot_note=154757>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ

trs.20: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.<sup foot_note=196948>1</sup>
trs.85: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
trs.22: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
trs.203: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

trs.20: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
trs.85: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
trs.22: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
trs.203: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious (Allâh), but they turn away therefrom.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

trs.20: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
trs.85: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
trs.22: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
trs.203: So they have indeed denied (the truth - this Qur’ân), then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

trs.20: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
trs.85: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
trs.22: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
trs.203: Do they not observe the earth - how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
trs.22: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily, in this is an Ayâh (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
trs.85: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
trs.22: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
trs.203: And (remember) when your Lord called Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Go to the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) -

trs.20: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
trs.85: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
trs.22: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
trs.203: "The people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): Will they not fear Allâh and become righteous?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
trs.85: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
trs.22: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
trs.203: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ

trs.20: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
trs.85: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
trs.22: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
trs.203: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Hârûn (Aaron) (to come along with me).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

trs.20: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
trs.85: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
trs.22: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
trs.203: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
trs.85: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
trs.22: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily We shall be with you, listening.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers<sup foot_note=196949>1</sup> of the Lord of the worlds,
trs.85: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.22: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
trs.203: "And go both of you to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and say: ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

trs.20: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
trs.85: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
trs.22: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
trs.203: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.’ "

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
trs.85: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

trs.20: And [then] you did your deed which you did,<sup foot_note=196950>1</sup> and you were of the ungrateful."
trs.85: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
trs.22: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
trs.203: "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man) while you were one of the ingrates."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

trs.20: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
trs.85: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
trs.22: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
trs.203: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

trs.20: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
trs.85: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
trs.22: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
trs.203: "So I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukm (i.e. religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood), and made me one of the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

trs.20: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
trs.85: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
trs.22: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
trs.203: "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."

trs.20: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
trs.85: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
trs.22: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
trs.203: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "And what is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

trs.20: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
trs.85: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
trs.22: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
trs.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
trs.85: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)?"

trs.20: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
trs.85: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
trs.22: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"
trs.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said,<sup foot_note=196951>1</sup> "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
trs.85: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman!"
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
trs.85: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
trs.22: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense!"
trs.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
trs.85: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison!"
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "If you choose an ilâh (god) other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."

trs.20: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
trs.85: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
trs.22: (Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing?"
trs.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Even if I bring you something manifest (and convincing)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
trs.85: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth!"
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.<sup foot_note=196952>1</sup>
trs.85: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
trs.22: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)!
trs.203: So [Mûsâ (Moses)] threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

trs.20: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
trs.85: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
trs.22: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
trs.203: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
trs.85: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
trs.22: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed:
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to the chiefs around him: "Verily! This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer.

verses.text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

trs.20: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
trs.85: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
trs.22: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"
trs.203: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
trs.85: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
trs.22: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-
trs.203: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;

trs.20: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
trs.85: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
trs.22: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."
trs.203: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."

trs.20: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.<sup foot_note=196953>1</sup>
trs.85: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
trs.22: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
trs.203: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.

trs.20: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.
trs.85: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
trs.22: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-
trs.203: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

trs.20: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
trs.85: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
trs.22: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
trs.203: "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

trs.20: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
trs.85: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
trs.22: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win?
trs.203: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

trs.20: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
trs.85: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
trs.22: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)."
trs.203: He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself)."

translation.text: the ones who are brought near

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

trs.20: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
trs.85: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’
trs.22: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw!"
trs.203: Mûsâ (Moses) said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

trs.20: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
trs.85: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’
trs.22: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win!"
trs.203: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), it is we who will certainly win!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

trs.20: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
trs.85: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery
trs.22: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake!
trs.203: Then Mûsâ (Moses) threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!

trs.20: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
trs.85: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,
trs.22: Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration,
trs.203: And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.

trs.20: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
trs.85: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
trs.22: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
trs.203: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
trs.85: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’
trs.22: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
trs.203: "The Lord of Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
trs.85: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
trs.22: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"
trs.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

translation.text: and I will surely crucify you

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

trs.20: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
trs.85: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
trs.22: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord!
trs.203: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord (Allâh) we are to return.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
trs.85: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
trs.22: "Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers!"
trs.203: "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers [in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

trs.20: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
trs.85: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
trs.22: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued."
trs.203: And We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses), saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."

trs.20: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers<sup foot_note=196954>1</sup>
trs.85: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
trs.22: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities,
trs.203: Then Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) sent callers to (all) the cities.

trs.20: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
trs.85: ‘These people are a puny band––
trs.22: (Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band,
trs.203: (Saying): "Verily these indeed are but a small band.

trs.20: And indeed, they are enraging us,
trs.85: they have enraged us-
trs.22: "And they are raging furiously against us;
trs.203: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.

trs.20: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
trs.85: and we are a large army, on the alert.’
trs.22: "But we are a multitude amply fore-warned."
trs.203: "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."

trs.20: So We removed them from gardens and springs
trs.85: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
trs.22: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
trs.203: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

trs.20: And treasures and honorable station<sup foot_note=196955>1</sup> -
trs.85: their treasures and their noble dwellings-
trs.22: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;
trs.203: Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.

trs.20: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
trs.85: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
trs.22: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.
trs.203: Thus [We turned them (Pharaoh’s people) out] and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

translation.text: And We caused to inherit them

trs.20: So they pursued them at sunrise.
trs.85: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
trs.22: So they pursued them at sunrise.
trs.203: So they pursued them at sunrise.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

trs.20: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
trs.85: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
trs.22: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
trs.203: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mûsâ (Moses) said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

trs.20: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
trs.85: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
trs.22: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
trs.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

trs.20: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
trs.85: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
trs.22: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.
trs.203: Then We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain.

trs.20: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
trs.85: and We brought the others to that place:
trs.22: And We made the other party approach thither.
trs.203: Then We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place.

trs.20: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
trs.85: We saved Moses and all his companions,
trs.22: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;
trs.203: And We saved Mûsâ (Moses) and all those with him.

trs.20: Then We drowned the others.
trs.85: and drowned the rest.
trs.22: But We drowned the others.
trs.203: Then We drowned the others.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
trs.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
trs.85: Tell them the story of Abraham,
trs.22: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story.
trs.203: And recite to them the story of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

trs.20: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
trs.85: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
trs.22: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"
trs.203: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ

trs.20: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
trs.85: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
trs.22: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."
trs.203: They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."

trs.20: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
trs.85: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
trs.22: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)?"
trs.203: He said: "Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?

trs.20: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
trs.85: Do they help or harm you?’
trs.22: "Or do you good or harm?"
trs.203: "Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

trs.20: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
trs.85: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
trs.22: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."
trs.203: They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."

trs.20: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
trs.85: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
trs.22: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-
trs.203: He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping -

trs.20: You and your ancient forefathers?
trs.85: you and your forefathers,
trs.22: "Ye and your fathers before you?-
trs.203: "You and your ancient fathers?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,<sup foot_note=196956>1</sup>
trs.85: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
trs.22: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
trs.203: "Verily they are enemies to me, save the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

trs.20: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
trs.85: who created me. It is He who guides me;
trs.22: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;
trs.203: "Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.

trs.20: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
trs.85: He who gives me food and drink;
trs.22: "Who gives me food and drink,
trs.203: "And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.

trs.20: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
trs.85: He who cures me when I am ill;
trs.22: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;
trs.203: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

trs.20: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
trs.85: He who will make me die and then give me life again;
trs.22: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);
trs.203: "And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

trs.20: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
trs.85: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
trs.22: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.
trs.203: "And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

trs.20: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
trs.85: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
trs.22: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
trs.203: My Lord! Bestow Hukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

trs.20: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
trs.85: give me a good name among later generations;
trs.22: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);
trs.203: And grant me an honourable mention in later generations.

trs.20: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
trs.85: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
trs.22: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
trs.203: And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

trs.20: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
trs.85: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
trs.22: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;
trs.203: And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.

trs.20: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
trs.85: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
trs.22: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-
trs.203: And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

trs.20: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
trs.85: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
trs.22: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
trs.203: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

trs.20: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
trs.85: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
trs.22: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart;
trs.203: Except him who brings to Allâh a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifâq (hypocrisy)]."

trs.20: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
trs.85: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
trs.22: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,
trs.203: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

trs.20: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
trs.85: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
trs.22: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;
trs.203: And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

trs.20: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
trs.85: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
trs.22: "And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-
trs.203: And it will be said to them: "Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allâh) that you used to worship.

verses.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

trs.20: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
trs.85: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
trs.22: "'Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?'
trs.203: "Instead of Allâh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?"

trs.20: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
trs.85: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
trs.22: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,
trs.203: Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghâwûn (devils, and those who were in error).

trs.20: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
trs.85: and all Iblis’s supporters.
trs.22: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.
trs.203: And the whole hosts of Iblîs (Satan) together.

trs.20: They will say while they dispute therein,
trs.85: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
trs.22: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:
trs.203: They will say while contending therein,

verses.text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
trs.85: ‘We were clearly misguided
trs.22: "'By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest,
trs.203: By Allâh, we were truly in a manifest error,

trs.20: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.22: "'When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;
trs.203: When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);

trs.20: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
trs.85: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
trs.22: "'And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.
trs.203: And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimûn [Iblîs (Satan) and those of human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors].

trs.20: So now we have no intercessors
trs.85: and now we have no intercessor
trs.22: "'Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),
trs.203: Now we have no intercessors,

trs.20: And not a devoted friend.
trs.85: and no true friend.
trs.22: "'Nor a single friend to feel (for us).
trs.203: Nor a close friend (to help us).

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."<sup foot_note=196957>1</sup>
trs.85: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
trs.22: "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"
trs.203: (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
trs.22: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: The people of Noah denied the messengers<sup foot_note=196958>1</sup>
trs.85: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
trs.22: The people of Noah rejected the messengers.
trs.203: The people of Nûh (Noah) belied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
trs.22: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When their brother Nûh (Noah) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

trs.20: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
trs.85: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
trs.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
trs.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
trs.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

trs.20: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me."
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.’
trs.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me."
trs.203: "So keep your duty to Allâh, fear Him and obey me."

trs.20: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
trs.85: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
trs.22: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"
trs.203: They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
trs.85: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
trs.22: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?
trs.203: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

trs.20: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
trs.85: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
trs.22: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.
trs.203: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know.

trs.20: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
trs.85: I will not drive believers away.
trs.22: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.
trs.203: "And I am not going to drive away the believers.

trs.20: I am only a clear warner."
trs.85: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
trs.22: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."
trs.203: I am only a plain warner."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

trs.20: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
trs.85: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
trs.22: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."
trs.203: They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death)."

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
trs.85: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
trs.22: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.
trs.203: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
trs.85: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
trs.22: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."
trs.203: Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

trs.20: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
trs.85: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
trs.22: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).
trs.203: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

trs.20: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
trs.85: and drowned the rest.
trs.22: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.
trs.203: Then We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
trs.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: ʿAad denied the messengers
trs.85: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
trs.22: The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers.
trs.203: ‘Âd (people) belied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
trs.22: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

trs.20: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
trs.85: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
trs.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
trs.203: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
trs.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).

trs.20: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,<sup foot_note=196959>1</sup> amusing yourselves,
trs.85: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
trs.22: "Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves?
trs.203: "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?

trs.20: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
trs.85: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
trs.22: "And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)?
trs.203: "And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein for ever.<sup foot_note=154758>1</sup>

trs.20: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
trs.85: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
trs.22: "And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power?
trs.203: "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: Be mindful of God and obey me;
trs.22: "Now fear Allah, and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

trs.20: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
trs.85: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
trs.22: "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.
trs.203: "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.

trs.20: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
trs.85: He has given you livestock, sons,
trs.22: "Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons,-
trs.203: "He has aided you with cattle and children.

trs.20: And gardens and springs.
trs.85: gardens, springs-
trs.22: "And Gardens and Springs.
trs.203: "And gardens and springs.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

trs.20: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
trs.85: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’
trs.22: "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."
trs.203: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

trs.20: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
trs.85: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,
trs.22: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!
trs.203: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.

trs.20: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
trs.85: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:
trs.22: "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,
trs.203: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

trs.20: And we are not to be punished."
trs.85: we shall not be punished.’
trs.22: "And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties!"
trs.203: "And we are not going to be punished."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
trs.22: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: Thamūd denied the messengers
trs.85: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.
trs.22: The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers.
trs.203: Thamûd (people) belied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
trs.22: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

trs.20: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
trs.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
trs.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
trs.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
trs.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
trs.85: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-
trs.22: "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-
trs.203: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?

trs.20: Within gardens and springs
trs.85: gardens, springs,
trs.22: "Gardens and Springs,
trs.203: "In gardens and springs.

trs.20: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
trs.85: fields, palm trees laden with fruit-
trs.22: "And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)?
trs.203: And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix.

trs.20: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
trs.85: carving your fine houses from the mountains?
trs.22: "And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill.
trs.203: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: Be mindful of God and obey me:
trs.22: "But fear Allah and obey me;
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

trs.20: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
trs.85: do not obey those who are given to excess
trs.22: "And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant,-
trs.203: "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

trs.20: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
trs.85: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’
trs.22: "Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)."
trs.203: "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

trs.20: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
trs.85: They said, ‘You are bewitched!
trs.22: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
trs.203: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
trs.85: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’
trs.22: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth!"
trs.203: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

trs.20: He said, "This is a she-camel.<sup foot_note=196960>1</sup> For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
trs.85: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,
trs.22: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.
trs.203: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

trs.20: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
trs.85: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’
trs.22: "Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you."
trs.203: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

trs.20: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
trs.85: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:
trs.22: But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets.
trs.203: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
trs.22: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.85: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.
trs.22: The people of Lut rejected the messengers.
trs.203: The people of Lût (Lot) (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine) belied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
trs.22: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When their brother Lût (Lot) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

trs.20: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
trs.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
trs.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
trs.203: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
trs.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

trs.20: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: Do you approach males among the worlds<sup foot_note=196961>1</sup>
trs.85: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males
trs.22: "Of all the creatures in the world, will ye approach males,
trs.203: "Go you in unto the males of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind),

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

trs.20: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
trs.85: and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’
trs.22: "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)!"
trs.203: "And leave those whom Allâh has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ

trs.20: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
trs.85: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’
trs.22: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out!"
trs.203: They said: "If you cease not O Lût (Lot)! verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"

trs.20: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
trs.85: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do:
trs.22: He said: "I do detest your doings."
trs.203: He said: "I am, indeed, of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your (this evil) action (of sodomy).

trs.20: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
trs.85: Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’
trs.22: "O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do!"
trs.203: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."

trs.20: So We saved him and his family, all,
trs.85: We saved him and all his family,
trs.22: So We delivered him and his family,- all
trs.203: So We saved him and his family, all,

trs.20: Except an old woman<sup foot_note=196962>1</sup> among those who remained behind.
trs.85: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
trs.22: Except an old woman who lingered behind.
trs.203: Except an old woman (his wife) among those who remained behind.

trs.20: Then We destroyed the others.
trs.85: then We destroyed the others,
trs.22: But the rest We destroyed utterly.
trs.203: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

trs.20: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
trs.85: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!
trs.22: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!
trs.203: And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
trs.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
trs.85: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.
trs.22: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.
trs.203: The dwellers of Al-Aikah [near Madyan (Midian)] belied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
trs.22: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh (and obey Him)?

trs.20: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
trs.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
trs.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
trs.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

trs.20: So fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
trs.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
trs.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

trs.20: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
trs.85: Give full measure: do not sell others short.
trs.22: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).
trs.203: "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others).

trs.20: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
trs.85: Weigh with correct scales:
trs.22: "And weigh with scales true and upright.
trs.203: "And weigh with the true and straight balance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

trs.20: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
trs.85: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.
trs.22: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.
trs.203: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.

trs.20: And fear He who created you and the former creation."<sup foot_note=196963>1</sup>
trs.85: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’
trs.22: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"
trs.203: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

trs.20: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
trs.85: but they replied, ‘You are bewitched!
trs.22: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
trs.203: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

trs.20: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
trs.85: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.
trs.22: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!
trs.203: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
trs.85: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’
trs.22: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"
trs.203: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

trs.20: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
trs.85: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’
trs.22: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
trs.203: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

trs.20: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
trs.85: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.
trs.22: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
trs.203: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
trs.22: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
trs.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
trs.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

trs.20: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.22: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.203: And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

trs.20: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
trs.85: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
trs.22: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
trs.203: Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down

trs.20: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -
trs.85: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
trs.22: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
trs.203: Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,

trs.20: In a clear Arabic language.
trs.85: in a clear Arabic tongue.
trs.22: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
trs.203: In the plain Arabic language.

trs.20: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
trs.85: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
trs.22: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
trs.203: And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

trs.20: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
trs.85: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
trs.22: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
trs.203: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm)<sup foot_note=154759>1</sup> of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?

trs.20: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners<sup foot_note=196964>1</sup>
trs.85: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
trs.22: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
trs.203: And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],<sup foot_note=196965>1</sup> they would [still] not have been believers in it.
trs.85: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
trs.22: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
trs.203: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

trs.20: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
trs.85: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
trs.22: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
trs.203: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

trs.20: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
trs.85: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
trs.22: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
trs.203: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

trs.20: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
trs.85: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
trs.22: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
trs.203: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

translation.text: And it will come to them

trs.20: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
trs.85: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
trs.22: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
trs.203: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"

trs.20: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
trs.85: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
trs.22: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
trs.203: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?

translation.text: So is it for Our punishment

trs.20: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
trs.85: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
trs.22: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
trs.203: Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,

trs.20: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
trs.85: and then the promised torment came upon them,
trs.22: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
trs.203: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

trs.20: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
trs.85: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
trs.22: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
trs.203: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

trs.20: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
trs.85: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
trs.22: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
trs.203: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners

trs.20: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
trs.85: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
trs.22: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
trs.203: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.

trs.20: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.<sup foot_note=196966>1</sup>
trs.85: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
trs.22: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
trs.203: And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.

trs.20: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
trs.85: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
trs.22: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
trs.203: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).

trs.20: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.<sup foot_note=196967>1</sup>
trs.85: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
trs.22: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
trs.203: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

trs.20: So do not invoke<sup foot_note=196968>1</sup> with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
trs.85: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
trs.22: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
trs.203: So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.

trs.20: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
trs.85: Warn your nearest kinsfolk
trs.22: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
trs.203: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.<sup foot_note=154760>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
trs.85: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
trs.22: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
trs.203: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
trs.85: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
trs.22: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
trs.203: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."

trs.20: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
trs.85: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
trs.22: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
trs.203: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

trs.20: Who sees you when you arise<sup foot_note=196969>1</sup>
trs.85: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
trs.22: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
trs.203: Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).

trs.20: And your movement among those who prostrate.<sup foot_note=196970>1</sup>
trs.85: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
trs.22: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
trs.203: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allâh in the five compulsory congregational prayers).

trs.20: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
trs.85: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
trs.22: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
trs.203: Verily He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ

trs.20: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
trs.85: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
trs.22: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
trs.203: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayâtîn (devils) descend?

trs.20: They descend upon every sinful liar.
trs.85: They come down to every lying sinner
trs.22: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
trs.203: They descend on every lying, sinful person.

trs.20: They pass on what is heard,<sup foot_note=196971>1</sup> and most of them are liars.
trs.85: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
trs.22: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
trs.203: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.

trs.20: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
trs.85: only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
trs.22: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
trs.203: As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

trs.20: Do you not see that in every valley they roam<sup foot_note=196972>1</sup>
trs.85: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
trs.22: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
trs.203: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people - right or wrong) in their poetry?

trs.20: And that they say what they do not do? -
trs.85: how they say what they do not do?
trs.22: And that they say what they practise not?-
trs.203: And that they say what they do not do.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

trs.20: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims]<sup foot_note=196973>1</sup> after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
trs.85: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
trs.22: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
trs.203: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allâh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.
